notes: re-scoped from the shared unit to sysml alone (ADR-0015)
decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.21.2. The clause and the Xtext state this production identically — `ownedRelatedElement += SatisfactionReferenceExpression` in both — so there is nothing to weigh. It contributes no tokens. Note that it carries no '=' or ':=' of its own, unlike the general FeatureValue of 8.2.2.6.2: the subject of a satisfaction is bound by position after 'by', not by an assignment operator, and this production exists to make that binding a FeatureValue in the model without any operator being written.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription.
Line 22 `satisfy vehicleSpecification by vehicle_design;` reaches this production below the 'by'; nothing between 'by' and `vehicle_design` is written, which is the point of the rule.
Second opinion. Identical to the clause.
